title: fix(merged-pr-feedback-sweep): flag COMMENTED-state advisory reviews with outside-diff-range findings
body:
## Background

`idd-advisory-convergence`'s required check is deliberately Copilot-only
(`primaryBotLogin`). This was decided in #909 (closed 2026-06-17) and
explicitly reaffirmed by the maintainer in #1352 (closed 2026-07-14,
comment 2026-07-14): "Keep the advisory-convergence dimension
Copilot-only; do not add an N-bot merge gate for the configured
non-Copilot bots." The accepted trade-off is that a non-Copilot bot's
(e.g. CodeRabbit's) finding can slip past merge, recovered afterward by
`merged-pr-feedback-sweep.mjs` (#931) — a manually-invoked, read-only
detector that scans merged PRs for feedback left unattended at merge.
**This issue does not propose changing that decision** — it fixes a gap
in the sweep tool that is supposed to be the safety net for exactly this
case.

**Observed incident.** On PR #2185 (2026-08-19), after an E-phase
branch-sync merge pulled in `main`'s latest content, CodeRabbit posted a
review whose `state` was `COMMENTED` (not `CHANGES_REQUESTED`). Its body
contained GitHub's own `<details><summary>⚠️ Outside diff range
comments (1)</summary>` block, flagging a citation-format claim on
`docs/idd-helper-scripts.md` line 1347 — content the diff-hunk view
cannot host as a normal inline review comment, so GitHub embeds it
directly in the review body text instead. No separate review thread or
regular PR comment was created for it; the finding exists only inside
that one `PullRequestReview` object's `body` field. (The finding itself
turned out to be false and was verified-and-rejected in the PR, so no
harm resulted this time — but the detection gap below is unconditional
on correctness.)

**Verified gap** (source-read, not inferred): `merged-pr-feedback-sweep.mts`'s
review-collection loop reads:

```ts
for (const review of reviews) {
  if (review.state !== 'CHANGES_REQUESTED') {
    continue;
  }
  ...
}
```

Every review whose state is not `CHANGES_REQUESTED` — including a
COMMENTED-state advisory-bot review carrying an "Outside diff range
comments" block — is skipped unconditionally. The sweep, whose whole
purpose (per #909/#1352's accepted design) is to catch exactly this
class of missed non-Copilot finding, currently cannot see this
particular content shape at all.

## Proposed change

Extend `merged-pr-feedback-sweep.mts`'s review-collection loop to also
flag a non-`CHANGES_REQUESTED` review when both hold:

- the review's author passes `isConfiguredAdvisoryBotIdentity` (the
  narrower, configured-only predicate this file already uses to gate
  its CodeRabbit-summary exclusion — not the broader `isAdvisoryBot`,
  which also recognizes bots outside the configured
  `advisoryBotLogins` set), and
- the review body contains a detectable "Outside diff range comments"
  block.

Be aware of the existing test `'a COMMENTED (non-CHANGES_REQUESTED)
review body is not feedback'` (currently using a plain `'overview'`
body) when adding fixtures — it must keep passing unflagged under the
new logic, since it has no outside-diff-range block.

Add a small, pure detection function in `merged-pr-feedback-sweep.mts`
(mirroring the existing `isReviewSummaryComment(comment.body)` /
`isAdvisoryNonReviewNotice(comment.body)` pattern already in this file)
— for example `hasOutsideDiffRangeFindings(reviewBody: string): boolean`
— that matches CodeRabbit's stable
`<summary>⚠️ Outside diff range comments (N)</summary>`-shaped heading
with `N >= 1`. Treat `N === 0` (or an absent block) as no finding, to
avoid flagging an ordinary walkthrough/summary review with nothing
outside the diff.

Add a short note to `idd-template/docs/idd-helper-scripts.md`'s "Merged-PR
feedback sweep" section documenting this detection case (this is a
sync-pair source file — do not hand-edit the generated
`docs/idd-helper-scripts.md` mirror; run `node scripts/sync-docs.mjs
--apply` after editing the source).

**Explicitly out of scope**: any change to `idd-advisory-convergence`,
`advisory-convergence.mts`, the E1 live triage flow
(`idd-review-snapshot.instructions.md`), or any merge-blocking gate.
This is a detection/reporting-only change to a read-only, manually-run
sweep helper.

## Acceptance criteria

- `merged-pr-feedback-sweep.mjs`'s output flags a non-`CHANGES_REQUESTED`
  review from a configured advisory bot whose body contains an "Outside
  diff range comments" block with `N >= 1`, including the review's URL
  and a body excerpt.
- A COMMENTED-state review with no such block (a plain walkthrough, a
  "no actionable comments" summary, or a Copilot "no new comments"
  body) is **not** flagged — no new false positives.
- Existing `CHANGES_REQUESTED` review flagging behavior is unchanged
  (no regression).
- New tests in `tests/merged-pr-feedback-sweep.test.mts` cover: (1) a
  COMMENTED review with an outside-diff-range block → flagged; (2) a
  COMMENTED review without one → not flagged; (3) a `CHANGES_REQUESTED`
  review → flagged exactly as before.
- `pnpm run build` regenerates `scripts/merged-pr-feedback-sweep.mjs`
  with no other diff.
- `node scripts/sync-docs.mjs --check` reports the helper-scripts doc
  pair in sync.
- `pnpm run lint:minimum` passes.

## Candidate files

- `src/scripts/merged-pr-feedback-sweep.mts`
- `tests/merged-pr-feedback-sweep.test.mts`
- `idd-template/docs/idd-helper-scripts.md` (source; mirrored to
  `docs/idd-helper-scripts.md` via an `exact`-mode sync pair)

Refs #909 #1352 #931
